# About

I hold an award-nominated MSc in mathematics and statistics. I have over 8 years experience with Python and R. I'm passionate about equity, diversity and inclusion in STEM. I'm an organizer for RLadies Ottawa! Checkout our site and upcoming events [here](https://rladies-ottawa.github.io/). Please reach out to get involved or learn more.

I am currently a Data Scientist in the Centre for Demography at Statistics Canada. My interests are in R package dev, population change, and having fun with code. Check out [my CV here](./about.qmd).
